name.ja: Figure-rise Standard ULTRAMAN SUIT Ver7.5(強行突入型) -ACTION-
name.en: Figure-rise Standard ULTRAMAN SUIT Ver7.5 (forced entry type) -ACTION-

description.ja: 「月刊ホビージャパン」連載の外伝ストーリー『ULTRAMAN SUIT ANOTHER UNIVERSE』より、「ULTRAMAN SUIT Ver.7.5」の強行突入型が登場！
description.en: From the side story "ULTRAMAN SUIT ANOTHER UNIVERSE " serialized in " Hobby Japan ", a forced entry version of " ULTRAMAN SUIT Ver.7.5" is now available!

description.ja: ■成形色にはブラックメタリックとダークグレーを採用し、重厚感を表現。
description.en: • The molding colors are black metallic and dark gray to create a solid feel.

description.ja: ■LEDを排除し、複数のボールジョイントで胸部と腹部を連結し可動させる独自の新技術を採用したことで、ひねり方向の可動域が大幅アップ。
description.en: • By eliminating LEDs and adopting a unique new technology that connects and moves the chest and abdomen using multiple ball joints, the range of motion in the twisting direction has been greatly increased.

description.ja: ■原作者・清水栄一氏によるオリジナルデザインの武器EYE SLUGGERが付属。
description.en: • Comes with the original designed weapon EYE SLUGGER by the original author, Eiichi Shimizu.

description.ja: ■WIDE SHOT、EX-RIFLEに加えて、二刀流を再現できるSPECIUM SWORDが２本付属。
description.en: • In addition to WIDE SHOT and EX-RIFLE, two SPECIUM SWORDs are included that can reproduce dual wielding.

description.ja: ■EX-RIFLEはプラモデルオリジナルの銃身拡張パーツ付き。
description.en: • EX-RIFLE comes with plastic model original barrel extension parts.

accessories.ja: オリジナル武器「EX-RIFLE拡張バレル」×２
ハンドパーツ　平手（左右）、握り手（左右）、EX-RIFLE持ち手（左右）
accessories.en: Hand parts Open hand (left and right), grip hand (left and right), EX-RIFLE handle (left and right)

accessories.ja: 台座用ジョイントパーツ×１
